description: UnitQuaternion completion: division, heterogeneous products with rotations, translations, isometries and similarities, rotation_between_axis, observer frames, from_matrix, mean_of, ln, exp

format.tolerance_unit: raw units (1 ulp = 2^-32), applies to every output scalar

ops.name: unit_quaternion_div
ops.tolerance: expected = floor(exact result), computed on i128 raws; 0: one rescale per output scalar reproduces it bit for bit

ops.name: unit_quaternion_mul_rotation
ops.tolerance: ceil(4 + 4 * A), A = max over outputs of sum over inputs of |d out / d in| (central differences)

ops.name: unit_quaternion_div_rotation
ops.tolerance: ceil(4 + 4 * A), A = max over outputs of sum over inputs of |d out / d in| (central differences)

ops.name: unit_quaternion_mul_translation
ops.tolerance: ceil(2 + 3 * A), A = max over outputs of sum over inputs of |d out / d in| (central differences)

outputs.name: result
outputs.layout: (translation (x, y, z), rotation (w, i, j, k))

ops.name: unit_quaternion_mul_isometry
ops.tolerance: ceil(2 + 3 * A), A = max over outputs of sum over inputs of |d out / d in| (central differences)

inputs.name: iso
inputs.layout: (translation (x, y, z), rotation (w, i, j, k))

outputs.name: result
outputs.layout: (translation (x, y, z), rotation (w, i, j, k))

ops.name: unit_quaternion_div_isometry
ops.tolerance: ceil(2 + 3 * A), A = max over outputs of sum over inputs of |d out / d in| (central differences)

inputs.name: iso
inputs.layout: (translation (x, y, z), rotation (w, i, j, k))

outputs.name: result
outputs.layout: (translation (x, y, z), rotation (w, i, j, k))

ops.name: unit_quaternion_mul_similarity
ops.tolerance: ceil(2 + 3 * A), A = max over outputs of sum over inputs of |d out / d in| (central differences)

inputs.name: sim
inputs.layout: (translation (x, y, z), rotation (w, i, j, k), scaling)

outputs.name: result
outputs.layout: (translation (x, y, z), rotation (w, i, j, k), scaling)

ops.name: unit_quaternion_div_similarity
ops.tolerance: ceil(2 + 3 * A), A = max over outputs of sum over inputs of |d out / d in| (central differences)

inputs.name: sim
inputs.layout: (translation (x, y, z), rotation (w, i, j, k), scaling)

outputs.name: result
outputs.layout: (translation (x, y, z), rotation (w, i, j, k), scaling)

ops.name: unit_quaternion_rotation_between_axis
ops.tolerance: ceil(16 + 6 * A), A = max over outputs of sum over inputs of |d out / d in| (central differences)

ops.name: unit_quaternion_scaled_rotation_between_axis
ops.tolerance: ceil(32 + 6 * A), A = max over outputs of sum over inputs of |d out / d in| (central differences)

ops.name: unit_quaternion_face_towards
ops.doc: UnitQuaternion::face_towards(&dir, &up), dir and up not parallel
ops.tolerance: ceil(16 + 6 * A), A = max over outputs of sum over inputs of |d out / d in| (central differences)

ops.name: unit_quaternion_look_at_rh
ops.doc: UnitQuaternion::look_at_rh(&dir, &up), dir and up not parallel
ops.tolerance: ceil(16 + 6 * A), A = max over outputs of sum over inputs of |d out / d in| (central differences)

ops.name: unit_quaternion_look_at_lh
ops.doc: UnitQuaternion::look_at_lh(&dir, &up), dir and up not parallel
ops.tolerance: ceil(16 + 6 * A), A = max over outputs of sum over inputs of |d out / d in| (central differences)

ops.name: unit_quaternion_from_matrix
ops.doc: UnitQuaternion::from_matrix(&m) (upstream's iteration, checked against the SVD maximiser of tr(R^T m); sign as upstream from the identity guess)
ops.tolerance: ceil(64 + 4 * A), A = max over outputs of sum over inputs of |d out / d in| (central differences)

ops.name: unit_quaternion_mean_of
ops.doc: UnitQuaternion::mean_of([q1, q2, q3]) un-permuted (see the suite doc), largest component positive, second eigenvalue below 0.8 of the first
ops.tolerance: ceil(16 + 8 * A), A = max over outputs of sum over inputs of |d out / d in| (central differences)

ops.name: unit_quaternion_ln
ops.tolerance: ceil(24 + 4 * A), A = max over outputs of sum over inputs of |d out / d in| (central differences)

ops.name: unit_quaternion_exp
ops.tolerance: ceil(16 + 8 * A), A = max over outputs of sum over inputs of |d out / d in| (central differences)
